decision_reason: The OCHA page published August 29 directly supports the August 23 warehouse-damage event in its August 28-labeled situation report; the event is distinct from the UNICEF nutrition/water story, and the report's limits on structural severity and stored-supply loss are preserved.

attribution_assessment.safe_future_wording: On its August 29 page for the August 28-labeled situation report, OCHA reported that an August 23 airstrike on an adjacent location damaged three UN humanitarian warehouses in Deir al-Balah; one sustained significant structural damage, two sustained lesser damage, and no major loss of stored supplies was reported.

evidence_references.supporting_passage: OCHA reported that three humanitarian warehouses sustained damage, including one with significant structural damage, after an airstrike on an adjacent location; it reported no major loss of stored supplies.
